title: Local Government System
description: Understanding the structure, functions, and importance of local governments in Nepal's federal system.

sections.title: Structure and Types
sections.content: Local government units include municipalities and rural municipalities with elected councils, executive heads, and sectoral committees coordinating service delivery.

sections.title: Functions and Mandates
sections.content: Responsibilities span primary education, basic healthcare, local infrastructure, sanitation, and community development programs tailored to local needs.

sections.title: Finance and Revenue Sources
sections.content: Local governments raise revenue through local taxes, fees, and intergovernmental transfers, enabling autonomy while adhering to fiscal responsibility norms.

sections.title: Citizen Participation and Accountability
sections.content: Public hearings, participatory planning, and social audits enhance legitimacy and responsiveness of local governance.

sections.title: Historical Transition to Federal Localism
sections.content: Transition from centralized administration to constitutionally empowered local units expanded functional assignments and fiscal discretion to address localized priorities.

sections.title: Capacity Development
sections.content: Training academies, peer learning networks, and standardized planning templates aim to reduce capacity variance between better‑resourced and emerging local units.

sections.title: Coordination Challenges
sections.content: Overlap with provincial mandates, data fragmentation, and procurement bottlenecks can slow service outcomes; integrated MIS and joint forums mitigate friction.

sections.title: Case Study: Local Health Outreach
sections.content: A coordinated health outreach initiative using local ward data improved immunization coverage and informed targeted budget reallocations.

sections.title: Future Outlook
sections.content: Focus areas: integrated digital service portals, performance-based grants, expanded participatory budgeting, and standardized outcome dashboards.

summary: Devolution created empowered local service units
Historical shift expanded functional & fiscal space
Capacity programs reduce variance across municipalities
Citizen participation & social audits strengthen legitimacy
Case evidence: data‑guided health outreach boosts outcomes
Future: digital portals & performance-based grant systems
